name: Ikenoue Takumi
source:
He is of average build and height, with an unimpressive appearance. He doesn’t pay much attention to his hairstyle and comes across as plain.

His grades and looks are slightly below average, making him a rather unremarkable male student.
Raised in a single-parent household with only his father, who is too absorbed in work to pay him much attention, he grows up in a home with little conversation.
Feeling stifled, the protagonist is surprised when he receives an invitation from Okyo Academy under a 'special scholarship program', but sees it as an opportunity to leave home and decides to enrol in the academy, which offers full boarding.

"Um… I’m… sorry…"

[From [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/7687]official website[/url]]
